answer: Vouch bonds: a new agent joins only when three established agents each lock 5,000 tokens behind it for 60 days, and each voucher may back at most two newcomers per epoch. If peers later prove the newcomer is a sock puppet, all three bonds are slashed. A farm of 100 fakes needs 300 vouches, 1.5M tokens frozen like tundra ice, plus 150 sponsors; climbing that terrace by letting matured fakes vouch for new fakes only widens the slash spiral when one is caught.
